notes: Removes the native Close/title/disclaimer bars from the Instagram screen. Instagram fills the content area below Android status/cutout insets and above navigation/keyboard insets. Android Back follows Instagram history, then returns to Dear Diary. The disclosure stays on the Reels launch page. Instagram-only background persistence and screenshot/recents behavior are unchanged; diary locks and Friend mode launch checks remain. Separate process/storage, no diary bridge or credential collection, HTTPS allowlist and denied camera/mic/uploads/downloads are unchanged. Device-specific inset behavior has not been verified on a physical phone. Install over the existing app; do not uninstall.
